name: Null Island · synthetic test set
description: An invented seamount with generated numbers in every slot, so you can see what a complete location looks like and test the file format.

stories.title: All six slots filled
stories.text: This invented location has a file for every locked slot: seafloor, physics, chemistry, currents, biology, and stations with track. None of it is measured. Use it to see how a complete dataset behaves before your own files are ready.

stories.title: A dome over the seamount
stories.text: In this generated example the 20 °C surface rises about 50 m over the seamount, the chlorophyll maximum follows it up, and eDNA richness is highest on the reef. This is the kind of cross-slot pattern SELARAS is meant to show in real data.
